I’m in: I’ll catch 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. My family taught me that this lake supports the whole village, and today our neighbors need treatment.

I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 tons monthly once the lake is back at capacity. Let’s record everyone’s commitments and confirm the total before we fish—an extra catch would put that recovery at risk.

Kate, can you join us on both the donation and the recovery limits?
